import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;
    static final long[] pow_arr = {1L, 10L, 100L, 1000L, 10000L, 100000L, 1000000L};
    static long[] prefix_sum = new long[7];
    static long total_answer = 0;
    static long counter1 = 0;
    static long limit;
    static long counter2 = 0;
    static List<Long>[] digit_vectors = new ArrayList[7];

    public static void generate(int level, long val) {
        if (level == 7) return;
        long modVal = (counter1 - val + MOD1) % MOD1;
        digit_vectors[level].add(modVal);
        prefix_sum[level] += modVal;
        counter1++;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            generate(level + 1, val * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    public static boolean is_in_range(long x) {
        return x * pow_arr[6] + 999999 <= limit && x * pow_arr[6] * 10 > limit;
    }

    public static void search(int level, long current) {
        if (current > limit) return;
        if (is_in_range(current)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long p = ((counter2 + 1 - (current * pow_arr[i])) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
                List<Long> vec = digit_vectors[i];
                int pos = lowerBound(vec, MOD1 - p);
                long size = vec.size();
                long sum = prefix_sum[i] + p * size - MOD1 * (size - pos);
                total_answer = (total_answer + sum) % MOD2;
            }
            counter2 += counter1;
            return;
        }
        counter2++;
        total_answer = (total_answer + ((counter2 - current) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
        int startDigit = (level == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int d = startDigit; d <= 9; d++) {
            search(level + 1, current * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    public static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        limit = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            digit_vectors[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digit_vectors[i]);
        }
        counter2 = -1;
        search(0, 0);
        System.out.println(total_answer);
    }
}
